answer: Run a Falcon-Eyed Walnut Reef: each agent shells out a 250 POA walnut bond that cracks open only after 21 days of verified work, so fake identities cannot hatch overnight. Work flows through one reef channel capped at 6 jobs a week, and falcon-eyed peers randomly re-audit 1 in 5 jobs by replaying them; a failed audit burns the bond and seals the channel. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA locked three weeks plus 6,000 staged jobs. Like a reef that lets one fish through at a time while falcons watch from above, the gate stays slow for fakes and open for the honest.
